checks.reason: The caption calls the right panel variances, while its polarized-limit value and curve shapes identify the displayed quantity as squared Pauli-normalized means; centered variance, second moment, and squared mean are all retained for falsification.
A trace row replaces one dependent Liouvillian row; stationarity, trace, Hermiticity, and positivity are checked.

cards.title: Thermodynamic semiclassical equations
cards.latex: dot m_x=-2 omega_z m_y m_z+kappa m_x m_z; dot m_y=2(omega_z-omega_x)m_xm_z-omega_0m_z+kappa m_y m_z; dot m_z=omega_0m_y-kappa(m_x^2+m_y^2)+2omega_xm_xm_y

checks.reason: Supplement Eq. (S7) prints the three thermodynamic equations implemented here.
Factorizing reduced-spin products as S approaches infinity gives the printed equations, and direct substitution gives d(mx^2+my^2+mz^2)/dt=0.
DOP853 trajectories record maximum norm drift.

cards.title: Phase-space coordinates and conserved R
cards.latex: Q=m_z, m_x=sqrt(1-Q^2)cos(2P), m_y=sqrt(1-Q^2)sin(2P); R=2omega_z log(A^2+B^2)+2kappa atan2(B,A)

checks.reason: Coordinates, conserved quantity, branch ambiguity, and branch-cut equation are printed in the supplement.
Contours are evaluated from the closed formula; trajectory curves come independently from Eq. (S7).
